## Corporate proxy

When `HTTPS_PROXY` or `HTTP_PROXY` is
set (either case), the CLI process sends its `fetch` requests through the proxy and honors `NO_PROXY`: MCPJam's API, model provide
rs and MCP servers over HTTP. `HTTPS_PROXY` covers `https` destinations and `HTTP_PROXY` covers `http` ones; with only `HTTP_PROXY
` set, `https` requests use it too. `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` always connect directly, so local MCP servers and the loc
al Inspector keep working. A value without a scheme, such as `proxy.corp.com:8080`, means `http://`; a value that is not an http(s
) URL is ignored with a warning. Two connections do not use the proxy yet: the relay connection of `mcpjam cloud tunnel` and the `
mcpjam oauth` debugging proxy.\n\nThe update check runs in a separate short-lived process that uses Node.js's own proxy support. O
n Node.js older than 22.21, or 24.x older than 24.5, the check is skipped while a proxy is set rather than sent directly.", "is_er
